title: Springr
tagline: Web3 airbnb for the vibe economy using on-chain reputation for recommendations and TBAs for in-app reputation building.
how_its_made:
Airstack for querying NFTs and providing recommendations based off wallet data.

ERC-6551 to create unique accounts for each user that mints an Access Pass NFT. Users can mint individual listings and then be paid for those. TBAs allow for loyalty points for power users.

We used IPFS for storing listing images/metadata.

Lit Protocol for token-gated authentication.
